fusions.name: Shot Bolt
fusions.desc: Throws a knife that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Razor Grille
fusions.desc: Raises a line of bladed bars 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. It deals 10 damage to anything that crosses it, knocks it 2 tiles back and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Portcullis
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 3 tiles in place for 2 seconds and leaves them [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fish in a Barrel
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
